description: This file defines a class 'Matrix' within the PhpSpreadsheet project, providing static methods for matrix operations such as transpose and index, as well as helper functions to identify vectors.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: Provides matrix manipulation functions such as transpose and index, serving as a utility class within the LookupRef namespace.

methods.name: isColumnVector
methods.description: Checks if the provided array of values is a column vector.

methods.name: isRowVector
methods.description: Checks if the provided array of values is a row vector.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Transposes a given matrix or scalar value into a 2D array form.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves a value or array of values from a matrix based on specified row and column numbers, supporting array inputs.
